name: io.github.connerkward/muser
description: Local-first semantic image search (SigLIP/CLIP + LanceDB), fully offline, no API keys.
title: Muser

environmentVariables.name: MUSER_SERVICE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the embedded muser service URL (default http://127.0.0.1:7777). The MCP server is a thin HTTP client of `muser serve` and auto-spawns it if it isn't already listening.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only used by the captioning / generate add-ons (GPT-4o-mini captions, gpt-image edits). Core search/index/color run on-device with no key.

environmentVariables.name: FAL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only used by the cloud generate pipeline (fal.ai image/3D/LoRA). Core search is fully local and never needs it.
